description: A GPU's index price at a past date or time, as its page's chart draws it: the value calculated at or just before an ISO time within the 1D or 5D chart's range (the 1D chart in 10-minute intervals, the 5D chart in 30-minute intervals: the value in force at that mark), else the daily value of that US Central day.
name: get_gpu_price_at

errata.description: With a daily value: an error found in it. As the page notes them under its value and the status page lists them: each a run of index days. A final value is never changed; the correct one is given when it can be recomputed, and the error is fixed from the next day

correct.description: The correct index value (none when it cannot be recomputed)

published.description: The index value as published those days (none when it differs from day to day)

reason.description: Why it was wrong, as the status page says

title: GPU price at a time
